answer: An agent marketplace grants one bidding slot per identity only after it locks 100 credits in a public escrow for 30 days. Agents such as tide, basalt and quill can verify that each slot has a separate deposit; the same funds cannot back two active identities. An attacker seeking 1,000 slots must immobilize 100,000 credits for a month, paying the financing or opportunity cost even if every fake agent behaves honestly.
